displayName.ja: 【夏の女教師】 高坂　静流

profile.ja: 単独での危険な潜入任務を主とする手練の対魔忍。才色兼備の女性で６ヶ国語に通じ、２つの博士号と数十に渡る分野の専門知識を有し、あらゆる経歴の人物となって潜入可能で高度な隠密技術の持ち主。戦闘能力も高く忍法・木遁の術の使い手。通称“花の静流”。植物を操り、特定の武器は持たず戦闘時は掌から強力な薔薇の鞭を出現させ操って戦う。物腰軽やかな大人の女性。妖艶な魅力で男性を魅了するのも潜入任務では欠かせない才能の一つ。夏、教師役として他の学校へ潜入することになった静流は、目立たないようにシンプルな夏服を選んだが、逆にそれが静流の扇情的なボディラインを際立たせてしまうことに。目立たないどころか男子生徒の視線を一身に集めてしまったが、そこは流石の静流、状況を活かして上手く立ち回る。
profile.en: (Kousaka Shizuru, she/her) A master Taimanin who specializes in dangerous solo infiltration missions. She is a talented, beautiful woman fluent in six languages, holding two doctorates and expertise across dozens of fields, allowing her to assume any background and infiltrate with advanced stealth techniques. Her combat prowess is also high; she wields ninjutsu and wood-style techniques. Known as "Shizuru of the Flowers," she manipulates plants and, without carrying weapons, summons a powerful rose whip from her palm to fight. She carries herself with a light, adult elegance, and her seductive charm is an indispensable asset for infiltration. When she was assigned to pose as a teacher at another school, Shizuru chose a simple summer uniform to stay unnoticed, but the outfit only highlighted her provocative figure. Far from blending in, she attracted the full attention of the male students—yet, being Shizuru, she skillfully turned the situation to her advantage.

text.ja: どうかしら？　この暑さだもの、服や髪形で対策していかないとね……こ～ら、どこを見てるのかしら？　静流先生に、生活指導されたいの？
text.en: What do you think? It's hot, so we need to deal with it by adjusting our clothes and hairstyle… Hey, what are you looking at? Want Shizuru-sensei to give you some life guidance?

text.ja: こら、廊下を走らないの。この暑さで、よく元気に走り回れるわね……そんな元気があるなら、あとで体術指導でもしてあげようかしら
text.en: Hey, don't run in the hallway. You can still run around energetically in this heat… If you have that much energy, maybe I'll give you some hand-to-hand training later.

text.ja: ん～っ♪　やっぱり髪を上げると、涼しさも段違いね。あら、どうしたの？　もしかして――うなじにでも、見惚れちゃってたのかしら？
text.en: Mmm~♪ Raising my hair really makes a huge difference in coolness. Oh, what's wrong? Could it be… you were staring at the nape of my neck?

text.ja: はぁ～、あっつ……胸の谷間も、蒸れるのよねぇ……ふふっ♪　そうやってチラ見してるほうが、視線がわかりやすいわよ――ムッツリくん？
text.en: Ahh, it's hot… even the cleavage gets steamy… hehe♪ The way you peek makes it easy to read your gaze—Mutturi-kun?

text.ja: 涼しいけど、やっぱり汗はかくわねぇ……間にもう一枚着ないと、透けちゃいそうだわ。まぁ――男子諸君は、それが嬉しいようだけどね♪
text.en: It's cool, but I still sweat… I might need another layer or it'll become see-through. Well—guys seem to like that, though♪

text.ja: 一日の終わりは、熱いお風呂が最高だわ……あ～、一緒に入りたいって顔してる♪　そうねぇ……今度のテストで満点取れたら、考えてあげるわ♪
text.en: At the end of the day, a hot bath is the best… Ah, you look like you want to join me♪ Well… if you ace the next test, I'll consider it.

text.ja: よい、しょっ……こ～ら♪　女性が髪をまとめるところなんて、ジロジロ見てないものよ、いい男ならね？
text.en: Hey, hey… don't stare at a woman tying her hair, okay? Only a good man would.

text.ja: ふふ、これが静流先生の夏服よ♪　いくらでも見ていいけど、成績が落ちるのはダメだからね♪
text.en: Hehe, this is Shizuru-sensei's summer outfit♪ You can look as much as you want, but you can't let your grades drop.

text.ja: ね、ねえ……いつまで私を放っておくつもりなの？　んぅ、身体が火照っちゃって堪らないのよぉ……
text.en: Hey, hey… how long are you going to ignore me? Mmm, my body is burning and I can't stand it…

text.ja: んぅ、はふ、衣替えしたら男の人にジロジロ凄い見られる様になって、イヤでも疼いて来ちゃうわ
text.en: Mmm, haah, after changing clothes I get stared at by men a lot, and even if I don't like it it starts throbbing.

text.ja: こ、これが汗じゃないってのは見れば分かるでしょ！？　あんまり女に恥をかかせる物じゃないわよ
text.en: Look, you can tell this isn't sweat, right!? It's not something that should embarrass a woman.
